# Virtual outpatient consultation rooms

!!! info "Definition"
    A virtual outpatient consultation room is a space equipped for healthcare professionals to conduct remote consultations with patients without requiring an in-person hospital visit.

## Activity classification

Activity is limited to virtual outpatient attendances classified in the first or follow-up consultation groups.

## Calculating capacity

#### Pathway: deriving workload

Calculate the effective consultation time by adding an allowance for time lost to appointments where patients do not attend (DNA).

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \begin{aligned}
    \text{Effective consult time (minutes)}
    &= \text{Consult time (minutes)} \\
    &\quad + \left(
    \frac{\text{DNA rate}}{1-\text{DNA rate}}
    \times \text{DNA time (minutes)}
    \right)
    \end{aligned}
    $$

Multiply attended virtual consultations by the effective consultation time, then convert minutes into hours.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \text{Consultation hours}
    =
    \frac{\text{Attendances} \times \text{Effective consult time (minutes)}}{60}
    $$

#### Operating model: converting workload to capacity

Calculate the required number of virtual consultation rooms by dividing consultation hours by the product of the service's annual operational hours and the assumed utilisation rate.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \begin{aligned}
    &\text{Required virtual consultation rooms} \\
    &=
    \frac{\text{Consultation hours}}
    {\text{Annual operational hours} \times \text{Utilisation rate}}
    \end{aligned}
    $$

## Assumptions

Assumptions may apply to an individual subgroup, several subgroups or all groups.

| Subgroup | Assumption | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| All groups | Consultation time | Pathway |
| All groups | Did not attend rate | Pathway |
| All groups | Did not attend time | Pathway |
| All groups | Utilisation rate | Operational |
| All groups | Annual operational hours | Operational |


## Notes

* Consultation durations are represented using a single average, which may not reflect variation between specialties.

??? info "Technical details"
    **Capacity outputs**

    * `OP_VIRTUAL_CONSULT_ROOMS`

    **Conversion archetype:** appointment-slot utilisation · `FRM_APPOINTMENT_UTIL`

    **Operational constraint:** available appointment time, adjusted for utilisation

    **Workload object:** `consultation_hours`

    **Classification expressions**

    | Subgroup | Expression |
    | --- | --- |
    | All groups | (`CLASS_OP_ATTEND` AND `CLASS_OP_VIRTUAL` AND (`CLASS_OP_GROUP_FIRST` OR `CLASS_OP_GROUP_FOLLOW_UP`)) |

    **Classification definitions**

    | ID | Definition | Rule |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | `CLASS_OP_ATTEND` | Outpatient activity within the Demand Model scope | atentype IN (1, 2, 21, 22) AND sex IN (1, 2) AND age BETWEEN 0 AND 90 |
    | `CLASS_OP_VIRTUAL` | Virtual outpatient activity | tele_attendance = 1 |
    | `CLASS_OP_GROUP_FIRST` | Outpatient activity assigned to the first-attendance group | group = "first" |
    | `CLASS_OP_GROUP_FOLLOW_UP` | Outpatient activity assigned to the follow-up group | group = "followup" |

    **Classification notes**

    * `CLASS_OP_ATTEND`: Age bounds are inclusive.
    * `CLASS_OP_VIRTUAL`: tele_attendance equals is_tele_appointment. Within the outpatient scope, atentype 21 or 22 gives tele_attendance = 1.
    * `CLASS_OP_GROUP_FIRST`: Assigned when has_procedures is false or null and is_first is true. Within the outpatient scope, atentype 1 or 21 gives is_first = true. Includes face-to-face and virtual activity.
    * `CLASS_OP_GROUP_FOLLOW_UP`: Assigned when has_procedures is false or null and is_first is false. Within the outpatient scope, atentype 2 or 22 gives is_first = false. Includes face-to-face and virtual activity.

    **Assumption references**

    | Subgroup | Assumption ID |
    | --- | --- |
    | All groups | `OP_VIRTUAL_CONSULT_TIME` |
    | All groups | `OP_VIRTUAL_CONSULT_DNA_RATE` |
    | All groups | `OP_VIRTUAL_CONSULT_DNA_TIME` |
    | All groups | `OP_VIRTUAL_CONSULT_UTIL` |
    | All groups | `OP_VIRTUAL_CONSULT_ANNUAL_OPERATIONAL_HOURS` |
